definitions: Serving to lessen or alleviate cognitive dissonance, which is the mental discomfort experienced by a person who simultaneously holds two or more contradictory beliefs, ideas, or values.
A strategy or behavior aimed at resolving psychological inconsistency.
examples: He adopted a dissonance-reducing strategy to justify his decision.
The company implemented dissonance-reducing measures to improve employee morale.
Her explanation was a dissonance-reducing attempt to reconcile her actions with her beliefs.
